translations.web: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—
translations.bsb: For the ruthless will vanish, the mockers will disappear, and all who look for evil will be cut down—
translations.kjv: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
translations.asv: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scoffer ceaseth, and all they that watch for iniquity are cut off;
